notes.title: Join our Discord!
notes.notes: [h1]Hey Dream Doctors 💊[/h1][p][/p][h2]We’ve just opened the official Discord server for [b]Doctor Dreams Simulator[/b]![/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3775270/Doctor_Dreams_Simulator"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3]This is the best place if you want to:[/h3][h3]      - Share your feedback and bug reports from the demo[/h3][h3]      - Suggest new ideas for the game and discuss mechanics[/h3][h3]      - Chat directly with the developer and other community members[/h3][h3]      - Get exclusive sneak peeks, news and development updates[/h3][h3]Your voice can really help shape the game — every suggestion and comment matters![/h3][p][/p][h3] If you enjoyed the demo or just want to follow the project closely, this is the place to be.[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][h3]👉 Join us here: [url="https://discord.gg/Zx4c7T2ymC"]Doctor Dreams Simulator Discord[/url]  [/h3][p][/p][p][/p][h3]👉 New Demo: [/h3][p][/p][h3][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3900630/Doctor_Dreams_Simulator_Demo"][/dynamiclink][/h3][h3]👉 Trailer: [/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="_qMQ9jWEBc4;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][/h3][h3]For us, the community is the most important part of this journey — we want to build [i]Doctor Dreams Simulator[/i] together with you.[/h3]

notes.title: New Demo for Doctor Dreams Simulator Coming This August!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][h2]Hello dreamers![/h2][h3]After months of hard work, [i]Doctor Dreams Simulator[/i] enters a new phase:[/h3][h3]We’re preparing the first public demo for this August, and with it, the first real impressions of the game will arrive.[/h3][p]What we want:[/p][list][*][p]Improve the experience in the clinic and the dreams[/p][/*][*][p]Polish the stealth and infiltration system[/p][/*][*][p]Refine the dialogues and narrative decisions[/p][/*][/list][p]We want the game to combine exploration, management, and psychological tension in a unique way, and this stage brings us much closer to that vision.[/p][h3]Thank you for following the project. If you're interested, add it to your wishlist and don’t miss what’s coming:[/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3775270/Doctor_Dreams_Simulator"][/dynamiclink]
Trailer here: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/_qMQ9jWEBc4?si=_khd7Jy8qFfutG0q"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]See you very soon![/b][/p]
